items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: Harry mostly played the clarinet with me all the time. There was Harry Shields, Brown Lee, Joe Lloyd Canner, myself

ctx.x: Casual engagements. Harry Shields was on that record. Harry Shields played.

Did he play with you much in those days? Yes. Yes. Mostly. Harry mostly played the clarinet with me all the time. There was Harry Shields, Brown Lee, Joe Lloyd Canner, myself, and I can't think of his name, but it was Brown Lee's brother-in-law that played the banjo.
Oh I have a note on the record, it was French, Barrowman French. That's his name, yeah.

items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: But then when I joined Sharky, or rather rejoined Sharky, I played the tenor.

ctx.x: Yeah. You played sax some, but you played clarinet mostly. Mostly clarinet.

Yeah. I played the baritone too then with Brownlee. But then when I joined Sharky, or rather rejoined Sharky, I played the tenor. Oh. Because he used Sidney Aragon, who played nothing but the clarinet.
Can you tell us anything about him? I never got to meet him. Sidney? Raymond talks a lot about him, but...
